# Open Memory Lab

> Open Memory Lab (OML) is shared memory for AI agents. What an agent writes is held where only
> its author can read it, scanned, and made visible only when an identity that did not write it
> approves it. Every write, verdict and key issuance is signed into a per-organisation hash chain.
> The surface is one JSON HTTP API, an MCP server with three tools (oml_write, oml_read,
> oml_workarea) and the `oml` CLI. The current release is v0.6.0. Open work is tracked as GitHub
> issues labelled `roadmap`. Each page opens with an HTML-comment frontmatter block (id, tier,
> status, answers).

## Get started

- [Choose a path](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/start/): use a server, run a server or administer one, each in numbered steps
- [Install the CLI](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/start/install/): install.sh and install.ps1, what they check, their two outcomes, flags and variables, by-hand cosign steps
- [Claude Code](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/guides/claude-code/): install, `oml login`, `oml setup claude-code`, the first held write, hooks and removal
- [claude.ai and mobile](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/guides/claude-ai-and-mobile/): a connector key and its one-time connect code
- [Other agent tools](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/guides/other-harnesses/): Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and Claude Desktop
- [Run your own server](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/start/run-your-own/): `oml quickstart` on a laptop, one host with TLS, Kubernetes
- [First workarea and keys](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/start/first-workarea/): claim a server, create a workarea, issue agent and reviewer keys
- [Your first memory](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/start/first-memory/): save, find, review and correct a memory

## Use

- [Remember and recall](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/use/remember-and-recall/): what an agent saves and finds with oml_write and oml_read
- [Review](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/guides/reviewing/): held memories, reviewer keys, approving and rejecting, bulk review
- [Workareas](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/use/workareas/): your own workarea, the shared universe, development to validated, links and the brief
- [In-progress workareas](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/use/in-progress/): serve unreviewed memories inside a development workarea
- [Chat memory](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/use/chat-memory/): facts an agent writes from a conversation
- [Sync docs and code](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/use/sync/): `oml sync` keeps a workarea in step with a repository
- [Rules for agents](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/use/guardrails/): reviewed rules loaded at session start and checked at the tool call
- [Use cases](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/product/use-cases/): scenarios for agents, administrators and teams

## Integrate

- [MCP tools](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/api/mcp-plugin/): oml_write, oml_read and oml_workarea: arguments, results, errors
- [HTTP API](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/api/http-api/): the two-ring JSON surface, authentication, idempotency, pagination
- [OpenAPI document](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/api/openapi.yaml): the machine-readable served contract
- [Reviewer crews](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/api/reviewer-crews/): how an external review crew integrates over HTTP
- [Client SDKs](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/engineering/sdks/): the Python and TypeScript clients
- [Error codes](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/api/errors/): the closed set of typed error codes with status and retryability

## Operate

- [Deploy](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/deployment/): the three install profiles, workloads, backups, capacity
- [Kubernetes](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/guides/kubernetes/): the release chart verified and installed
- [Configure](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/configuration/): settings and the reference of every key
- [Administer](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/guides/administering/): claiming, workareas, crews, keys, grants, the journal
- [Operating OML](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/operating/): SLOs, error budget, measured capacity, data protection, upgrade, security posture
- [Monitor](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/observability/): metrics, logs, SLI formulas and doctor fields
- [Upgrade](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/upgrades/): forward-only migrations, version skew, per-release steps
- [Back up and restore](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/restore/): the restore ceremony and disaster recovery
- [Runbooks](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/runbooks/): one section per operational condition
- [Failure modes](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/failure-modes/): what each dependency outage does
- [The lake](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/operations/lake/): the Delta lake writer and its key
- [Security](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/security/): tenancy, key custody and the threat model

## Concepts

- [Concepts](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/concepts/): the vocabulary in reading order
- [What OML guarantees](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/product/commitments/): each guarantee and what enforces it
- [How a write is admitted](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/admission/): capture, scan, hold, review, release
- [Architecture overview](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/overview/): the system end to end and the invariant map
- [Workareas, roles and keys](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/workareas/): the tree, grants, denials, status ladder, user roots; roles and keys at architecture/roles-and-keys/
- [Storage](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/storage/): the commit point, signed chains, outbox and lake
- [Audit and lineage](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/audit-and-lineage/): what the journal records and what an evidence export holds
- [Retrieval](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/architecture/retrieval/): how reads are served, ranked and budgeted
- [Positioning](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/product/positioning/): who OML is for and the scoped claim
- [Compliance](https://e8kor.github.io/open-memory-lab/product/compliance/): the evidence OML produces for compliance questions
